checks.name: default API is a loopback read-only reader with no implicit collection
corrupt materialized record returns 503 without killing the reader and recovers after repair
backup CLI and restored-directory verification preserve source bytes and snapshots
damaged raw provenance fails verification and blocks backup
verify refuses an absent archive rather than creating a misleading empty one

limits: Local temporary directory and loopback process only; not a real host reboot, off-host restore or unattended service test.
